sourcedFrom: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) (2014 (© Copyrights 2014, printed in the imprint))
cleanIntro: ⛔ ONE 3 MM ALLEN KEY AND FOUR STEPS. The Xesse Sport strips by loosening the cover bolt, pulling the cover down, swinging the trigger guard fully down and holding it, then taking the slide back and up over the guides and off the front. That is the whole published strip. ⚠ WALTHER TIMES THE CLEAN AT ABOUT 1000 ROUNDS, and after shooting outside says a wipe with a lightly oiled cloth is generally enough — so for a high-volume shooter the wipe is the after-session job and the strip below is the one that comes round on the counter. ⛔ One thing that is NOT optional on this pistol: dry firing without the buffer plug, a round or an empty case can damage the firing pin, slide and frame.

steps.title: Walther's safety check is six steps and it runs before the tools come out
steps.action: Take the gun firmly, finger off the trigger, muzzle in a safe direction. Check the safety and put it on if it is not. Open the slide and lock it open. If the magazine is still in, drop it. Remove all ammunition including cases. Then check the barrel for foreign objects, dirt or grime.
steps.prose: Note the order: safety on BEFORE the slide is opened, magazine out AFTER. Walther runs the same six-step check before shooting, after shooting, after a break and on any malfunction.
steps.quote: Remove any ammunition, such as rounds and shell casings.
steps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 4.1 Secure the weapon and check/unload the weapon, printed p.47

steps.title: Where the strip is allowed to happen
steps.action: Walther puts a condition on the workspace itself before step 1 — a clean, distraction-free environment, with the safety check done first.
steps.prose: It reads like boilerplate until you have lost an extractor spring off a cluttered bench. On a match pistol the small parts are small.
steps.caution: Safety check first, every time — the disassembly section points back at 4.1 rather than repeating it.
steps.quote: First perform a safety check (see 4.1 Secure the weapon and check/
steps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 4.4 Disassemble the weapon, printed p.50

steps.title: 3 mm Allen key, cover bolt counter-clockwise
steps.action: Loosen the mounting bolt on the cover with the 3 mm Allen wrench, turning it counter-clockwise. It loosens; it does not need to come out.
steps.prose: This is the only tool the strip needs. Keep the key with the gun — without it the Xesse does not come apart at all.
steps.quote: Loosen the mounting bolt on the cover with the 3 mm Allen wrench by turning it counter-clockwise.
steps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 4.4 Disassemble the weapon, printed p.50

steps.title: Pinch the cover recess and pull it down
steps.action: Grasp the recess in the cover between thumb and index finger, press the two sides together, and pull the cover downward off the gun.
steps.prose: The squeeze is what releases it. Pulling straight down without pressing just flexes the cover.
steps.quote: Grasp the recess in the cover between the thumb and index finger. Press together and pull the
steps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 4.4 Disassemble the weapon, printed p.50

steps.title: Trigger guard fully down — and HELD there
steps.action: Swing the trigger guard all the way down and hold it in that position. It is not a latch that stays put; it is held with one hand while the other takes the slide off.
steps.prose: This is the step people try to do with one hand and cannot. Set the gun down, get both hands on it, then move the slide.
steps.quote: Swing the trigger guard all the way down and hold it in this position.
steps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 4.4 Disassemble the weapon, printed p.50

steps.title: Slide back, up over the guides, then forward and off
steps.action: With the other hand, grasp the fluted end of the slide. Pull it all the way to the rear and UPWARD over the guides, then guide it forward and remove it. Back, up, forward — in that order.
steps.prose: The up-over-the-guides move is the one that is not obvious from looking at the gun. Pulled straight back it stops and feels like something is wrong.
steps.aside: upward over the guides. Guide the slide forward and remove it.
steps.quote: With the other hand, grasp the fluted end of the slide. Pull the slide all the way to the rear and
steps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 4.4 Disassemble the weapon, printed p.50

steps.title: Bore from the chamber end until the lead is gone
steps.action: Starting from the CHAMBER side of the barrel, push an oiled brass or copper wire brush up the bore until all the lead deposits are gone. Then take the residue out with cleaning pads, felt wads or a wool mop.
steps.prose: Chamber-end first is the rule on any gun whose crown you care about, and on a match .22 the crown is the accuracy. Walther writes the direction into the step.
steps.aside: bore until all of the lead deposits are gone.
steps.quote: Starting from the chamber side of the barrel, push an oiled brass or copper wire brush up the
steps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 4.5 Care and cleaning, printed p.51

steps.title: Nylon brush on the five named areas, then the magazines the same way
steps.action: With a SOFT NYLON brush clean the barrel seat, feeder ramp, guides, magazine well and slide, and finish by wiping those parts down with a lightly oiled rag. Then clean the magazines exactly the same way.
steps.prose: Nylon, not brass, on these surfaces. The five areas Walther names are precisely where rimfire wax and unburnt powder collect on this design.
steps.quote: Clean the barrel seat, feeder ramp, guides, magazine well, and slide with a soft nylon brush.
steps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 4.5 Care and cleaning, printed p.51

steps.title: Grease — acid-free, and only on the grooves and combs
steps.action: Lubricate the GUIDE GROOVES AND GUIDE COMBS with a small amount of acid-free grease. That is the only place grease is named. Everything else gets a lightly oiled cloth and nothing more.
steps.prose: "A small amount" is doing work in that sentence. Grease in the rails holds grit; grease anywhere else on a rimfire holds wax.
steps.caution: Use only cleaning kits made for weapons, which available in any specialty store.
steps.quote: Lubricate the guide grooves and guide combs with a small amount of acid-free grease.
steps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 4.5 Care and cleaning, printed p.51

steps.title: Back together, and the hammer has to be set
steps.action: Reassemble by running the four steps in reverse. ⛔ One thing is added at the end and it is not part of the reverse order: make sure the trigger is tensioned by pulling the hammer rearward and downward until it clicks into place.
steps.prose: Skip it and the gun goes together, looks right, and does not fire. Walther prints it as its own sentence under the strip for that reason.
steps.quote: Make sure that the trigger is tensioned by pulling the hammer rearward and downward until it clicks into place.
steps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 4.4 Disassemble the weapon, printed p.50

deepSteps.title: Grip plates off — one screw, flat-head, and this is Walther's own route in
deepSteps.action: The Xesse grip is two plastic grip plates. Rotate the screw counter-clockwise with the supplied flat-head screwdriver and both plates come off. Refit by reversing. This is the only published route past the field strip on this pistol.
deepSteps.prose: With the plates off you can reach the frame sides that the field strip never exposes — and on a Sport this is also the access the let-off adjustment needs.
deepSteps.quote: The two grips plates can now be removed.
deepSteps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 3.3.4 Grip [8], printed p.44

deepSteps.title: ⚠ Magazines are inspected, not stripped — and Walther says what to look at
deepSteps.action: The Xesse magazine holds ten rounds and the left side is windowed so you can see the count. Walther publishes NO magazine teardown; what it publishes is an inspection, and it names the two parts: check the follower spring and the magazine feed lips from time to time for wear.
deepSteps.prose: On a rapid-fire gun the lips are the part that goes first and the failure shows up as a feed stoppage that gets blamed on ammunition. Look at them on a schedule.
deepSteps.caution: Inspect the lips and the follower spring. There is no published strip for this magazine.
deepSteps.quote: Check the follower spring and magazine feed lips from time to time
deepSteps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 3.3.5 Magazine [9], printed p.44

deepSteps.title: The Sport's own front sight — three widths on one part, and it rotates
deepSteps.action: The Sport version carries an INTEGRATED front sight with three widths (3.2 / 3.6 / 4.0 mm) in one piece. Loosen screw [18] with a 1.5 mm Allen key and the sight rotates in the housing; align the flat you want facing REARWARD, then tighten [18]. Check it is tight after cleaning — it is a rotating part held by one screw.
deepSteps.prose: This is the part of the Sport most likely to be disturbed by a cleaning rag and least likely to be noticed. A sight that has rotated a third of a turn is a different gun.
deepSteps.caution: Confirm screw [18] is tight before the gun goes back in the case.
deepSteps.quote: The Sport version of the Xesse has an integrated front sight with
deepSteps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 5.2.1 Adjustable integrated front sight, printed p.55

deepSteps.title: Match grip — 4 mm key, and it is a size adjustment not a teardown
deepSteps.action: The Sport's anatomically moulded plastic grip is size-adjustable. Loosen the mounting screw [21] with a 4 mm Allen key, make the adjustment, then tighten it again. Walther publishes no further breakdown of the grip.
deepSteps.prose: Worth checking on the same schedule as the front sight screw. A match grip that has crept is felt long before it is seen.
deepSteps.quote: The Xesse-Sport pistol is equipped with an anatomically molded plastic handle. Its size is adjustable.
deepSteps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 5.2.3 Match grip, printed p.56

deepSteps.title: ⛔ The match trigger's let-off screw sits behind the grip — and it is a 1.5 mm offset key
deepSteps.action: The Sport's match trigger adds a trigger-pull weight screw [22], set with a 1.5 mm Allen key. The LET-OFF weight is different: a small threaded pin [23] lives inside the let-off adjustment screw [17] and the grip has to come off to reach it, using a 1.5 mm OFFSET key. Clockwise increases, counter-clockwise decreases.
deepSteps.prose: This is why the grip-plate step above is the deep-clean access point and not a curiosity — it is the only way to the let-off pin. ⛔ And it stays a settings job: Walther's own rule elsewhere in this book is that no component is adjusted beyond what the manual describes.
deepSteps.aside: to be removed. Removal of the grip is described in 3.3.4 Grip [8].
deepSteps.quote: To adjust the trigger let-off weight, the grip has
deepSteps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 5.2.4 Match trigger — Let-off weight [23], printed p.57
deepSteps.warn: Improper adjustments impair the safety and reliability of the pistol and may lead to injury or death.

deepSteps.title: Storage — uncocked, buffered, lightly oiled, and away from the ammunition
deepSteps.action: Store dry and dust-free, weapons and ammunition separately, and protect against corrosion with a light coat of oil. Walther adds two conditions specific to this pistol: it goes away UNLOADED with the firing mechanism not under tension and secured, and the dry-firing buffer goes in — which also proves the chamber is empty when the slide is closed.
deepSteps.prose: The buffer doing double duty as a chamber flag is a genuinely good detail and worth using deliberately.
deepSteps.quote: Avoid exposing the weapon to large temperature fluctuations in order to avoid condensation in
deepSteps.cite: Hämmerli Xesse Bedienungsanleitung / Instruction Manual — Xesse instruction manual, four-language edition (DE/EN/ES/FR) — 4.6 Storage and transport, printed p.52
deepSteps.warn: Protect the weapon against corrosion by applying a light coat of oil.

cleaning.name: BORE
tasks: Oiled brass or copper wire brush until the lead is gone
Pads, felt wads or a wool mop to lift the residue out

cleaning.name: THE FIVE NAMED AREAS
tasks: Barrel seat · feeder ramp · guides · magazine well · slide
SOFT NYLON brush, then a lightly oiled rag

cleaning.name: LUBRICATION
tasks: Acid-free grease, a small amount, guide grooves and combs ONLY
Lightly oiled cloth over the exterior
⛔ Oil residue out of magazine and barrel before shooting

cleaning.name: TIMING
tasks: Wipe-down with a lightly oiled cloth after shooting outside

reassembly: Slide back onto the guides — the reverse of back-up-forward.
Cover pressed and pushed back up into place.
⛔ Hammer pulled rearward and downward until it CLICKS — the trigger must be tensioned.
Buffer plug in for storage and transport.
fncheck: Empty gun, buffer plug in. Work the slide through its full travel and let it snap — never ride it forward, which Walther states as a rule for loading and which is just as true on the bench. Confirm the slide catch holds the slide open and drops it, confirm the safety moves to both positions, and confirm the trigger is tensioned: pull the hammer rearward and downward until it clicks. ⛔ If it will not click into place the gun is not ready, whatever else looks right. Before you shoot it again, Walther is explicit that any oil residue must come out of the magazine and the barrel first.
